design: Exploratory sensitivity analysis selected after observing high abstention in the primary blind condition. Not a pre-registered or representative estimate. Primary prompt/results remain unchanged.
changed_prompt: Only the abstention instruction is changed: request an approximate chart even if uncertain.
interpretation: Compares sensitivity to asking for approximate charts. Do not combine its six-reference-song averages with the 40-song primary averages or use it to establish a model ranking.
